There’s going to be people from within the kingdom fighting amongst themselves to take all that power and run with it.”“It sounds like you know what Arthur will need to do.”A year after Arthur’s death, Gwen has also died. Merlin panics about what will come next for Camelot, until Arthur’s sudden return forces Merlin to confront the feelings he has been trying to avoid for the last year.
